es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Reservoir hits Suno and Anthropic with copyright infringement lawsuits
items.summary: Reservoir Media is the latest music rightsholder taking aim at AI companies in the courts. It’s gone with a double-pronged attack, suing both Suno and Anthropic on the same day this week. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Claude’s lyrics are diluting real lyrics, say music publishers in latest Anthropic proceedings
items.summary: The big debate over whether or not AI training is fair use under US copyright law was taking place in court again yesterday, this time in the context of music, specifically lyrics, with the copyright legal battle between AI company Anthropic and the Universal, Concord and ABKCO music publishers

items.title: Reservoir sues Suno and Anthropic for infringing songs by Joni Mitchell, Johnny Cash, Madonna and more

items.summary: Canberra, Australia – Today a group of 63 international media organizations led by the News/Media Alliance delivered a letter to senior Australian politicians asking them to reject proposed changes to the country’s copyright laws that would allow artificial intelligence companies to use copyrighted material in training…

Musixmatch compra Music Reports, dueña de Songdex
items.summary: Musixmatch ha comprado Music Reports, la compañía de Los Ángeles propietaria del registro de derechos de autor Songdex. La operación, anunciada el 19 de octubre, incluye también la plataforma londinense de datos y licencias Blokur y el software de hojas de música Cuetrak, ambos de Music Reports. Es la primera adquisici…

items.title: Former Eminem employee faces up to five years in jail after pleading guilty to stealing and selling unreleased music files
items.summary: In January 2025 unreleased Eminem tracks started to mysteriously appear online, prompting an FBI investigation that linked the leaks to one of the rapper’s former employees, Joseph Strange. He has now pleaded guilty to criminal copyright infringement and faces up to five years in jail

items.title: RIAA Flags Anna’s Archive and AI Voice Cloner to U.S. Government
items.summary: The RIAA has submitted its latest overview of "notorious markets" to the U.S. Government. It lists familiar names such as The Pirate Bay and Rapidgator, but the music group also flags shadow library Anna's Archive and AI voice-cloning service Lalals. The RIAA presents both as "additional" areas of concern, not as offic…

items.title: La SGAE alerta en Miami: la IA está sustituyendo a autores
items.summary: La directora general de la Sociedad General de Autores y Editores (SGAE), Cristina Perpiñá-Robert, alertó el 20 de octubre en Miami de que la inteligencia artificial puede «reemplazar por completo» a los creadores humanos, y pidió más regulación para protegerlos. Lo hizo en un panel de la Billboard Latin Music Week, se…

tip.title: Split sheet firmado el mismo día de la sesión
tip.body: Los porcentajes de autoría se pelean cuando la canción pega, no cuando se escribe. Firma el split sheet con todos los presentes antes de salir del estudio, aunque sean amigos.

tip.title: Sign the split sheet the day of the session
tip.body: Songwriting splits get disputed when the song blows up, not when it's written. Sign a split sheet with everyone in the room before you leave the studio —even with friends.
